narrative_purpose: Capture the chapter at a glance: a Na'vi rider on a flying mount carrying live fire across a dead volcanic landscape — a people who turned the thing that destroyed them into the only material they have left.
subject: A tall blue-skinned Na'vi rider seated on a large winged flying creature with a long membrane wing on each side, seen from the side and slightly below, banking across the frame. In one hand the rider holds a small pierced grey stone bowl with a single glowing orange coal inside it, the only bright warm point in the picture. The rider wears dark hide and bone, with pale ash markings on the arms.
scene: High above a vast grey volcanic ash plain, a low ridge on the distant horizon leaking two thin pale plumes of vapour, the sky a dim ashen indigo with layered haze. No vegetation anywhere in the frame.
camera: Wide cinematic side view from slightly below the flyer, the rider and mount placed in the upper third, the grey plain filling the lower two thirds.
light: Dim overcast ambient light from above; the single glowing coal in the stone bowl is the brightest thing in the frame, throwing a small pool of warm orange onto the rider's hand and chest and nothing else.
palette: Cool grey and deep indigo across nearly the whole frame; one small ember-orange point at the coal with a tight warm falloff on the hand holding it.
style: Painterly speculative-biology naturalist plate, bleak and observed, not dramatic action art.
detail_level: Crisp on the rider, the bowl and the near wing; the plain and the far ridge dissolve into flat grey atmospheric haze.
composition: Strong horizontal emptiness with the flyer high and off-centre, the coal placed at the visual focus, generous dead grey negative space below and to one side.
consistency_notes: A bleak volcanic wasteland on Pandora: grey tephra, dim ashen sky, distant venting ridge. The mood is grim endurance, not spectacle. Cool grey-indigo dominant with exactly one small warm ember point. This rider and this pierced stone ember bowl recur through the chapter — dark hides, bone ornament, ash markings, a light grey pumice bowl pierced with holes on one side.
negative_prompt: no text, no lettering, no numbers, no labels, no green rainforest, no neon glow, no big fire or explosion, no 3D-render or photographic look, no cartoon style
